rule: Tile the small pattern to fill the larger output grid
insight: The input is a repeating unit - scale up by copying it in a grid pattern

rule: Extend each colored line until it hits the grid boundary
insight: Lines are seeds that grow in their natural direction until blocked

rule: Find the unique colored cell and flood-fill its enclosed region
insight: The single different-colored pixel marks which region to fill
Pure rotation transformation - no other changes

rule: Overlay the two grids - where both have color, output has color
insight: Boolean AND operation on two patterns

rule: Replace each colored pixel with a 3x3 block of that color
insight: Scale up by factor of 3 - each pixel becomes a block

rule: Complete the symmetric pattern across the axis of symmetry
insight: Find the partial symmetry and mirror to complete it

rule: Move all colored objects to align at the bottom edge
insight: Gravity simulation - objects fall down until they stack

rule: Color in cells based on the number pattern encoded in the input
insight: Numbers are encoded spatially - decode and render

rule: Find the bounding box of all colored pixels and crop to it
insight: Tight crop - remove all empty border rows/columns
